correctness.rationale: The local rule and cyclic space-time graph bijection were checked with explicit time-column indexing. The 4- and 64-state integer adjacency determinants are computed from all traces through dimension by exact Newton identities, proving the polynomial identities rather than fitting finite sequences. Subtraction of fixed from third-return states counts three-phase orbits; the positive coefficient expansion proves the precise support n=7 or n>=9; the unique smallest positive zero of Q gives the asymptotic with constant 1/3. Separate direct state enumeration for every binary ring n=3..16 agrees with determinant counts. No finite experiment is used as proof of an infinite claim.
